limitations: Only finite abelian groups of odd order, over splitting fields of nonmodular characteristic.
The theorem does not decide non-split, modular, or general nonabelian quandle cases.
Possible implicit coverage by a broader treatment of images of bilinear maps or Fourier commutator forms remains a residual originality risk.
scientific_integrity: The general theorem is proved by character algebra and an explicit determinant-cycle construction. The finite diagnostic checker is supplementary; no independent audit has been performed. The dimension of the commutator span was already established through the Alexander-quandle group-ring theorem and is not claimed as new.
title: Commutator width one for split odd-order core quandle algebras
